title: Reduce complete P112 compatibility replay time by 76.09% (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Reduce the complete PR1325 primary scientific replay's local median time by 76.09%, from 1.365 seconds to 0.326 seconds, across five alternating runs per side. All ten runs pass with identical scientific stdout.

```text
complete partner-space vector filter
  -> restrict independent bit-string basis rows
  -> subtract the restricted binary rank
  -> identical complete scientific object and ordered plane digest
```

Claim type: scoped implementation-preservation proof with finite conformance evidence and a local performance observation. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Only `research/p112-compatibility-kernels/` is added. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Credit Philipp / mightyOil's PR1325 for the census, decoder theorem, witnesses, primary implementation and existing coefficient-space nullity checker. Binary elimination and rank-nullity are classical. The new contribution is the faster direct row-restriction evaluator preserving the primary command's entire receipt; it is not another verification of the predecessor theorem. The predecessor and its credit lines remain unchanged.

## Evidence

Before, the compatibility queries mask 33,553,920 partner-space vectors. After, they mask 816,510 basis rows, with bounded binary elimination and four bases prepared once. The new verifier counts all 97,920 queries. The complete 32,385-plane and 765-vector domains, canonical plane digest, witnesses and all six source rejection controls are retained.

Local CPython 3.12.15 / macOS arm64 checks pass at head `ed5455e9897c95d9d52d340aba066d3ba65f570f`:

- Warning-strict normal and optimized registered commands, individually timed at 0.365 and 0.371 seconds, below their 120-second limits.
- All 67 subspaces of F2^4 under all sixteen masks, 320 wide fixtures and five boundary controls, compared with literal vector enumeration.
- Complete scientific receipt comparison, byte-identical generated JSON, overwrite rejection and an actual changed-source rejection.
- Registered metadata/pins; committed-byte and source-history preflight for all sixteen package/input files; AST/function-size inspection.
- Official export and all eight declared-input coverage checks; normal and optimized read-only Git-free replays with empty PATH; all seventeen exported files including the manifest remain unchanged.

The benchmark times whole subprocesses with the same `-I -O -W error -B` flags, including startup, source hashes, complete census, witnesses, controls and receipt comparison. Source wall times range from 1.306152 to 1.656254 seconds; replacement times range from 0.293263 to 0.338164 seconds. All ten exit codes are zero, stderr is empty and stdout hashes agree. The shared 18-CPU host had other research/Git work active. A separate untimed profile identifies the compatibility scans as the main source cost. README records every sample and the exact timing scope. This is host-specific evidence, not a CI performance gate.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/p112-compatibility-kernels/fast.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p112-compatibility-kernels/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-compatibility-kernels
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-compatibility-kernels --check-source-history
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B research/p112-compatibility-kernels/benchmark.py --write /tmp/p112-kernel-benchmark.json
```

A reviewer may substitute their CPython 3.12 executable and choose a fresh benchmark output path. Standard library only. Direct markers are `PASS_SPARSE_REDUNDANT_DECODER` and `PASS_P112_COMPATIBILITY_KERNELS`; the latter is a generated receipt bound to all eight package files.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This opt-in evaluator is pinned to the exact source contract. It does not accelerate the predecessor's independent implementation or full test package. It supplies no new COPY floor, decoder, paid profile, physical delivery, dirty restoration contract, native supplier, stock/precision/tape theorem or complete multiplication theorem. No selected cold replay, Lean or Docker suite was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The `census-pruning-audit` card changes scope from predecessor validation to an original exact census evaluation improvement. Base main remains `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. The selected binding positive control passed. Main, merged PRs, live claims and open PRs were searched before claim and commitment. Cached overlap reports 370 open PRs and 6,297 Discussion records, but only 114 of 8,917 local notes in this sparse checkout; separate main-tree searches supplement it. This is bounded overlap coverage, not a novelty certificate.

## Open next questions

Can the same restriction evaluator accelerate a different complete decoder census? First profile its full command and identify its exact binary restriction contract. Ordering, receipts and rejection controls must be preserved separately; no automatic transfer is proved. Research stops at this first verified improvement.

- #6424 gives a rational rank-three quotient-direction counterexample; it computes no P112 compatibility count, ordered plane digest or runtime comparison.
- #5088 searches two-star P112 support dictionaries; this change performs no new support or COPY63 search.
- #5064 checkpoints masked completions and bases; this change preserves a fixed source census.
- #2832 studies general decoder floors and batching reductions; output preservation proves no new floor.
- #3154 reduces the general P112 floor to conjectures; this fixed evaluator settles none of them.
- #3074 studies P112-to-P120 padding; no padding theorem is supplied here.
- #3045 studies fitting matrices and root-code floors; no fitting-matrix classification is supplied here.
- #3029 studies two-sided deficiency budgets; this evaluator does not change its hypotheses or coefficients.
- #2985 studies one-sided residue closures; this change computes no new residue or COPY floor.
- #3566 binds a tetrad decoder to selected ports; its source alphabet and physical obligations differ.
- #3604 studies tetrad fusion and consumer costs; this change evaluates no such invoice.
- #3916 audits dirty-input tetrad coefficients; this change audits no coefficients or dirty-input contract.

- #4090 accelerates a P112 deletion census; its domain and scientific receipt differ.
- #2375 accelerates frame-pair enumeration; this evaluator instead changes partner-space restriction evaluation.

No extra computations were run to check these submissions or compare their numerical claims. The only scientific numbers preserved here belong to the pinned PR1325 receipt.

The completion refresh inspected this account's ten other open PRs created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-11-02T22:19:44Z: #6422–6429 and #6431–6432. The adjacent decoder scopes #6424 and #6425 are distinguished above. No common numerical endpoint disagrees; no additional computation checked another contribution.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks, `plan` and `replay (research/p112-compatibility-kernels)`, passed at exact head `ed5455e9897c95d9d52d340aba066d3ba65f570f` in [Registered research packages run 41537292036](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41537292036). The completed checks were confirmed once with `gh pr checks 6430 --repo CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds`; separate run metadata confirms completed status, success and the matching head.

Hosted replay executes both registered warning-strict normal and optimized conformance commands and source metadata validation. Every local scientific, publication and portable-export check recorded above also passed. CI certifies execution of these finite checks, not a portable speed guarantee or independent mathematical acceptance. No failed or waived check remains. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. Shared code, frozen inputs, predecessor credit and selected frontier are unchanged.
